pose_semantics: Reset each joint to captured bind local transform. Set quaternion from THREE.Euler(x,y,z,XYZ) or equivalent jointQuaternionsXYZW; add pelvisShift to joint__pelvis bind local position. Never accumulate. Source mathutils extrinsicXYZ inputs are recorded separately, not reusable as THREE intrinsic Euler angles.
reference_source: P01.3 actual saved FK poses, read independently in Blender; no new pose math predicted the expected anchors.
reset: Neutral bind, all15quaternions identity and pelvisShift zero; repeat after every non-neutral pose.
scope: Base4sampled FK and reset only; no gait/cart/equipment/driver workflow acceptance.
